experiment.description: Tech Shorts: the narrator ~9% faster (0.92 -> 1.0, ~151 -> ~164 words a minute) with ~10% more words, against the channel's own pace (owner: 'increase the pace a little'; judged on held after the hook)
experiment.on: Pace for this Short (weekly loop, cycle 1, faster-voice, on): the narrator speaks about 9% faster (the channel's 0.92 x 1.09, about 165 words a minute; renderer/timeline/build.py does it), so write about 10% more words for the same 45-60 s (125-165 words), the extra words saying what the picture shows; a new picture every 3-5 s as always.
experiment.off: Pace for this Short (weekly loop, cycle 1, faster-voice, off): the channel's own pace (about 150 words a minute, 110-150 words for 45-60 s), as the recipe says.
experiment.why: 0 of 8 Shorts a side have two days of data; day 0 of 7
